chunks.text: Today we will talk about Sophia.
Sophia is the capital city of Bulgaria.
It is in the western part of the country near mountains.
Sophia is famous for its history, churches and green parks.
The city is big, busy and full of life.
People enjoy walking in the streets and visiting old buildings.
Part two.
Where is Sophia?
Sophia is in western Bulgaria near the Vytosha mountain.
Part it is not far from the border with Serbia and North Macedonia.
The city is in a valley with rivers and parks around it.
Sophia is the largest city in Bulgaria and the center of culture, business and government.
Part three.
A short history of Sophia.
Sophia is very old.
People have lived here for more than 7,000 years.
It was part of the Roman Empire, the Ottoman Empire and Bulgaria.
Many old buildings and churches show the history of Sophia.
Today, Sophia is modern, but it keeps its traditions and history alive.
Part four.
Landmarks of Sophia.
Sophia has many landmarks.
One famous place is the Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, a big church with golden domes.
Another is the Boyana church with old paintings and decorations.
You can also see the National Palace of Culture, a big modern building for events.
Each landmark tells a story about Sophia's past and present.
Part five.
Vytosha mountain.
Vytosha mountain is near Sophia.
People go there to hike, ski and enjoy nature.
In winter, there is snow for skiing.
In summer, people hike and have picnics.
From the top of the mountain, you can see the whole city.
Nature is very important for life in Sophia.
Part six.
Parks and green spaces.
Sophia has many parks and gardens.
Borosalva Gradina is a big park with trees, flowers and walking paths.
People relax, jog and play sports in the parks.
Green spaces make the city fresh and calm.
Part seven.
Food in Sophia.
Food in Sophia is tasty and simple.
People eat meat, vegetables, bread and dairy.
A popular dish is bonita, a pastry with cheese and eggs.
Other foods include Shopska salad, yogurt and grilled meat.
People enjoy cafes, restaurants and street food.
Part eight.
Markets and shopping.
Sophia has many markets and shops.
Central Market Hall is famous for food, vegetables and souvenirs.
People also enjoy shopping in modern malls.
Markets are colorful, busy and full of local life.
Part nine.
People of Sophia.
People in Sophia are friendly and hardworking.
Many speak Bulgarian and some speak English.
People enjoy family, music and culture.
They celebrate traditional festivals and modern events.
People are proud of their city and history.
Part 10.
Weather in Sophia.
The weather in Sophia has four seasons.
Winter is cold with snow.
Spring is warm with flowers.
Summer is sunny and hot.
Autumn is colorful with leaves.
People enjoy outdoor activities in all seasons.
The weather changes the feeling of the city.
Part 11.
Culture and festivals.
Sophia has many cultural events.
The Sophia International Film Festival and music festivals are very popular.
People enjoy theater, concerts and art exhibitions.
Culture is important for the people and makes the city lively.
Part 12.
Goodbye from Sophia.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
Sophia is a city of history, culture, mountains and parks.
You can walk in old streets, visit churches, eat delicious food and enjoy nature.
It is a city full of life, beauty and traditions.
I hope you can visit Sophia one day and see its charm.
